candidate.blueprint_topic: Medication mechanism and expected therapeutic effect
candidate.educational_objective: Explain that intermittent teriparatide therapy is anabolic to bone because it preferentially stimulates osteoblastic activity and new bone formation rather than merely treating pain or suppressing all remodeling.

options.A: With its intermittent daily exposure, teriparatide preferentially stimulates osteoblastic activity over osteoclastic activity, promoting new bone formation.
options.B: Teriparatide works only as an analgesic and does not produce a meaningful effect on bone formation or skeletal mass.
options.C: Teriparatide suppresses all bone remodeling by permanently inactivating both osteoblasts and osteoclasts.
options.D: Teriparatide strengthens bone primarily by coating the bone surface and preventing calcium from entering bone tissue.

candidate.rationale: A is correct. The current teriparatide prescribing information explains that the skeletal effect depends on the pattern of systemic exposure. Once-daily administration stimulates new bone formation on trabecular and cortical bone surfaces by preferentially stimulating osteoblastic activity over osteoclastic activity. In humans, these anabolic effects are associated with increased skeletal mass and bone strength. B, C, and D do not reflect the labeled mechanism. The final item avoids an unnecessary comparison with another osteoporosis drug class and tests the teriparatide mechanism directly from the current label.
candidate.source_claim_supported: The current DailyMed label directly supports the intermittent anabolic mechanism, preferential osteoblastic activity, new bone formation, and increased skeletal mass/bone strength.
candidate.source_document_title: TERIPARATIDE injection, solution — Full Prescribing Information
candidate.source_locator: Section 12.1 Mechanism of Action: skeletal effects depend on systemic-exposure pattern; once-daily administration stimulates new bone formation on trabecular and cortical surfaces through preferential osteoblastic over osteoclastic activity; human anabolic effects include increased skeletal mass and bone strength. Section 12.2 Pharmacodynamics: teriparatide also affects calcium and phosphorus metabolism consistent with PTH physiology.
candidate.source_organization: DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine
